status: WORKING NON-CANON; synthetic mathematical verification only
scope: W01 stage 1: spherical, Cartesian, local-frame, unit and time conventions; not polygons or a W01-W02 forcing adapter

conventions.spherical: longitude east-positive, geocentric latitude north-positive, radial height up-positive; explicit sphere radius
conventions.cartesian: planet-centred right-handed X at lon=0/lat=0, Y at lon=pi/2/lat=0, Z north; identified axes
conventions.local: ENU at explicit origin; optional positive rotation of local X from east towards north; full 3D chord coordinates, NOT a flattening map
conventions.longitude: canonical [-pi,pi) or [-180,180); inverse longitude is zero only on the exact polar axis
conventions.pole_orientation: local-frame origin longitude explicitly selects its polar meridian; no inferred east at a pole
conventions.legacy: east/south/up reflection; polar and axial vector rules are distinct
conventions.time: SI seconds increasing forward within a named epoch; geological-before coordinates require an explicit reverse axis
conventions.year: Julian year = 31557600 SI seconds only when explicitly selected; no calendar/UTC/TAI conversion

acceptance.reference_radius_meaning: synthetic test scale, not Earth calibration
acceptance.unsupported: nonfinite or masked inputs, centre of sphere, unresolved nonzero height/time increments, unrelated frames/epochs without explicit mapping
